issues.description: Project/exercise naming is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement title (problem_statement.md) defines the exercise as "H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon" while the Gradle project names in the repositories use a different exercise identifier and description: template repository settings.gradle declares rootProject.name = 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House' and solution repository settings.gradle declares rootProject.name = 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution'. This mismatch between 'H02E02 / Seal Saloon' and 'H04E01 / Burger House' can confuse students about which exercise they are working on and which materials correspond to the instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the exercise identifier and descriptive name consistent across the problem statement and repository metadata. For example, either update both settings.gradle files to use rootProject.name = 'H02E02---Panic-at-Seal-Saloon' or update the problem statement to reference 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House'. Ensure the same identifier (H02E02 vs H04E01) and the same descriptive phrase (Seal Saloon vs Burger House) appear in the problem statement and both repositories so students can unambiguously map instructions to the codebase.
